label.purpose: Fields, table headings, and compact actions.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift the complete desktop work panel from the page field.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable transitions and smooth scrolling when the user requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that advances or completes the current workflow gate.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0f6d40; border-radius: 8px; background: #0f6d40; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #168a53; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #168a53 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #222; font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #168a53 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Area Tabs
components.description: Horizontal navigation between signing, documents, contracts, and webhooks.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8; } .ds-tab { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 transparent; font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab.ds-active { color: #0f6d40; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #168a53; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #168a53 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Block
components.description: A flat task region inside the complete app panel.
components.html:
Choose a PDF

Files are read from your Nextcloud account.
components.css: .ds-work-block { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #222; font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-work-block h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-work-block p { margin: 0; color: #5f6368; max-width: 70ch; }

components.name: Connection Status
components.description: Compact connection health shown beside connect or disconnect actions.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #222; font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { width: 9px; height: 9px; content: ''; border-radius: 50%; background: #168a53; }

narrative.overview: The extension is an operational surface inside Nextcloud. It inherits the host system and reserves Assinafy green for workflow and successful states.
keyCharacteristics: Assinafy green reserved for active workflow and success
Linear send flow with a distinct price gate

rules.name: The Operational Accent Rule
rules.body: Green carries a state or primary action; it is not decorative filler.

rules.name: The Host Theme Rule
rules.body: Neutral colors come from Nextcloud variables with safe fallbacks.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: The complete work panel may lift; nested tasks stay flat and bordered.

dos: Do inherit Nextcloud theme variables for neutral surfaces and text.
Do keep quote review adjacent to the final send action.
donts: Don't use Assinafy green on controls that are not primary, selected, or successful.
Don't add shadows to nested task regions.
